column1: # The NPC kernel's tunables: one row per retail number a kernel body reads (spec 0019 story 4).
# `uv run elysium research gen_kernel_tunables` renders this file into
# committed files AND reads every row back out of the pinned `Vampire/dlls/vampire.dll` at the
# width the row states. A body reads the NAME; the address and its provenance live here, once.
#   address   the image VA, lower-case, no `0x`: the cell, the instruction (imm_*), or the ConVar
#   name      PascalCase, unique; the C++ name in `namespace ElysiumNpcTunables`. A cell MSVC
#             pooled (one literal every body that spelled it shares — 1.0f, 0.5f, 100.0f) has no
#             single meaning and is named by its VALUE (`One`, `Half`, `HalfDouble`); a cell one
#             body owns is named by what it bounds. A body binds its own role name to the tunable.
#   type      f32 | f64 | i32 | u32    an .rdata/.data cell at that width (the reading
#             imm_f32 | imm_i32        a PUSH imm32 / MOV r/m32, imm32 at the address
#             convar_f32 | convar_i32  a ConVar read at +0x28 (float) or +0x2c (int)
#   value     the shortest decimal that rounds to the stored bits, or a ConVar's default string
#             verbatim (`ConVar::Create` parses it with atof and atoi)
#   evidence  one line: the reading instruction, the readers, what it bounds; a ConVar row opens
#             with the console name in backticks
# Seeded 2026-09-22 from `docs/vtmb/npc-ai/rdata-cells.md` (31 of its 32 cells: the reflected
# CRC-32 table at 0x10496f58 is a standard table under a mechanism body, not a threshold),
# `convars.md` (all 42), and the movement cells the 0019/1 seam rows keep "as a tunable". The rest
# of the kernel's inline cells move here family by family as 0019/6 touches them; `--report` is
